name: Compact header
steps: Open Online Store > Themes > Customize for an unpublished copy. Choose the page template, select Add section, and choose Compact header.
Connect your own content and media before adjusting layout, typography, color, and spacing. Section overrides take priority where the section offers them.
Preview desktop and mobile, test any links or controls, and save. Publish only after reviewing the complete customer journey.

settings.label: Transparent header on homepage
settings.how: Turn on “Transparent header on homepage” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.

settings.label: Header width
settings.how: Choose one of the supported options below for header width. Only the selected option applies; other settings can further customize its appearance.

settings.label: Menu
settings.info: Optional. If blank, Header One uses the global desktop menu setting.
settings.how: Create or edit a menu in Content > Menus, then select it here. Nest links to create dropdown levels. Preview both desktop navigation and the mobile menu.
